messages:
Jules Martin: Quick sync — model-catalog launch prep. We have three incoming open models (artemis-7b, cormorant-13b, lighthouse-2.6b). Need: legal signoff, perf profiles, and runtime quantization recommendations. Who can own each lane?

Eli Wang: I can own perf for artemis + lighthouse. Will run latency/throughput sweep on p4d and g5. Need sample prompt set from product (happy-path + adversarial).

Priya Sharma: I'll take legal review. First flag: cormorant-13b license looks like a CC-NC variant in the repo — send me the exact license file and source URL. If that's NC we need product signoff on allowed use. @Jen Park please confirm business use.

Tom O'Neill: Runtime/quant owner here. Initial take: artemis looks stable for symmetric int8 (w/ per-channel quant). lighthouse has some ops that may break kernels — need model graph bake. Minimal config I'm trying locally:```
model: artemis-7b
quant: int8_sym
calibration: 2k_samples
batch_size: 8
max_seq: 1024
```
I'll push a small patch to the quant-profiles repo after the probe.

Jen Park: Product confirms we need commercial-use allowed for cormorant's expected customers. If license blocks that, we either request relicensing or flag it as non-hosted catalog. Will sync with legal.

Jules Martin: Ownership matrix draft: artemis -> Eli perf / Tom runtime / Priya legal; cormorant -> Eli perf / Priya legal (hold) / Tom runtime (probe); lighthouse -> Eli perf / Tom runtime / Jen product. I'll own rollout checklist and gating.

catalog-bot: New draft entries created: artemis-7b (status: perf pending), cormorant-13b (status: legal review), lighthouse-2.6b (status: runtime probe). Link: https://catalog.internal.redwood/models/draft (internal).

Eli Wang: Timeline ask — can we aim for perf runs by EOD Thursday? That gives Tom a day to test quant configs before Friday canary.

Priya Sharma: I'll review cormorant license today and post findings here. If it's CC-NC we escalate to legal_ops for relicensing outreach.

Tom O'Neill: Will allocate a GPU slot on the quant-run queue — tagging @infra for quota bump if it fails.

Jules Martin: Great. Quick action items: 1) Jen to share prompt sets (pinged) 2) Eli to post perf summary w/ p50/p95/p99 and token/sec 3) Tom to attach quant config PR 4) Priya to post legal verdict. Followups here, please keep short updates. :thumbsup:

Eli Wang: ack.

Priya Sharma: ack, started.

Tom O'Neill: ack, will update PR link here.
